counterfactual_missing_items: erythrocyte sedimentation rate of 13 mm/hour and a C-reactive protein of 4.3 mg/L (both within normal limits)
Radiographs of the hands, knees, ankles, and feet were unremarkable
Hand ultrasound showed no joint erosion
decisive_items: symmetric pain in the small joints of her hands, wrists, knees, and ankles
early morning stiffness lasting 2 hours daily
anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody of 237.39 units (normal <20 units)
response.rationale: R3 is strongly supported by symmetric small-joint pain, prolonged morning stiffness, and highly specific anti-CCP/RF positivity with MRI synovitis/tenosynovitis. R4 relies only on a temporal COVID trigger and lacks the classic reactive arthritis pattern; R5 is nonspecific ANA positivity without a more specific autoimmune diagnosis, and R1 is contradicted by negative ENA/dsDNA.

rejected.why: Only ANA positivity; negative ENA and dsDNA antibodies and no SLE-specific clinical features.
ANA positivity alone is nonspecific and does not explain the highly specific anti-CCP antibody.
